statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below the block threshold despite extreme cross-asset and event stress.
recommendation: Current Tail is low; the next modeled concentration of conditional path risk is the September 23 U.S. cash-open, Flash PMI and Fed-speech window.
headline: Low Tail despite extreme stress; next risk cluster is September 23 U.S. open
body: December NQ is around 30,890 within a roughly 30,850-30,916 session range, while the cash Nasdaq is near record territory. Oil and Treasury yields have eased from earlier highs, VIX was recently low, and Fed rhetoric remains inflation-focused. The available evidence does not show a persistent no-retracement NQ path, so Tail remains low while Stress stays extreme.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock-hours, Tail peaked at 38% during the September 21 U.S. session, then normalized sharply. September 22 briefly reached 27% after the record-high cash open before retracing to 19% by 17:00 UTC, while Stress stayed predominantly extreme.
outlookSummary: Tail is modeled as low through most of the overnight and European session, with a brief WATCH around the U.S. power hour. The next major conditional concentration is September 23: WATCH before the open, 30% during the 13:30 cash open/13:45 Flash PMI hour, and 29% during the 14:05 Barr/post-PMI hour if one-way structure persists.

forecast.analysis: December NQ is near 30,890 inside a 30,850-30,916 session range while the cash Nasdaq is near record territory. The price path remains two-way rather than pinned at the high; softer oil and Treasury yields reduce immediate pressure, while geopolitical and Fed risk keep Stress extreme.
